subject.title: fix(ollama): remote Ollama streaming stalls at model_call:started on slow hosts

question: Should native Ollama `timeoutSeconds` become an idle/no-progress streaming timeout while chunks arrive, matching sibling stream transports, instead of the documented total guarded-fetch cap?
rationale: The code path is likely the right owner boundary, but the change alters a documented timeout contract for existing provider configurations and needs human acceptance plus live proof.

options.title: Accept idle timeout after proof and docs
options.body: Require redacted remote/slow Ollama proof and update the Ollama timeout docs, then merge the narrow provider-owned fix.

options.title: Keep the total timeout contract
options.body: Reject or revise this PR so `timeoutSeconds` remains a hard total cap during streaming.

options.title: Pause until live validation exists
options.body: Keep the PR open but do not merge until a maintainer or contributor can prove the reported setup completes after the change.

recommendation.title: Accept idle timeout after proof and docs
recommendation.body: Require redacted remote/slow Ollama proof and update the Ollama timeout docs, then merge the narrow provider-owned fix.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans provider runtime behavior, Ollama docs, and guarded-fetch semantics, all areas with relevant recent history from this owner candidate.
